en.headline: Hong Kong Food Carnival continues at Kwai Chung Sports Ground
en.dek: The nine-day event organised by the Chinese Manufacturers’ Association features more than 330 booths across seven zones, with entry at HK$6 and free admission after 7 p.m.
body: The 13th Hong Kong Food Carnival is under way at Kwai Chung Sports Ground and runs until 1 November, according to the organisers, the Chinese Manufacturers’ Association of Hong Kong.

More than 330 outdoor booths are arranged in seven thematic zones, including a newly added Southeast Asian food area. Cooked-food sections offer around 80 stalls with local and international options. Entry costs HK$6, while children under one metre in height, people aged 65 or above, and persons with disabilities enter free. Admission is also free from 7 p.m. each day.

The event includes side activities such as spinning-top competitions on the opening days and various performances. Organisers said the fair aims to provide a range of food and shopping options for families and visitors during the nine-day period.

zh.headline: 香港美食嘉年華葵涌運動場進行中
zh.dek: 中華廠商聯合會主辦的九日活動設超過330個攤位、七大主題區，入場費6元，晚上7時後免費。
body: 第13屆香港美食嘉年華正在葵涌運動場舉行，至11月1日結束，主辦機構為香港中華廠商聯合會。
場內設有超過330個戶外攤位，分為七大主題區，當中包括新增的東南亞美食區。熟食區約有80個檔口，提供本地及各地美食選擇。入場費為6元，身高1米或以下小童、65歲或以上長者及殘疾人士免費入場，每日晚上7時起亦免費。
活動期間有爆旋陀螺比賽等附設項目及多項表演。主辦方表示，嘉年華為期九日，為市民及遊客提供不同美食及購物選擇。
